paper_title: Guided Search Strategies in Non-Serializable Environments with   Applications to Software Engineering Agents
caption: : Critic learns to distinguish successful and unsuccessful trajectories for GPT-4o.
model_annotation: The diagram shows the average critic score over time for different policies and trajectory outcomes. The y-axis is labeled "Average critic score" and has a range from 0.2 to 0.8 with a linear scale and no units. The y-axis tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 0.1. The x-axis is labeled "Time (relative)" with a range from 0.0 to 0.9 with a linear scale and no units. The x-axis tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 0.2. There are four lines in the diagram: a green solid line representing "GPT-4o policy, successful", starting at (0.0, 0.3) and ending at (0.9, 0.85); a red solid line representing "GPT-4o policy, unsuccessfull", starting at (0.0, 0.25) and ending at (0.9, 0.25); a green dashed line representing "GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, successful", starting at (0.0, 0.35) and ending at (0.9, 0.95); and a red dashed line representing "GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, unsuccessfull", starting at (0.0, 0.25) and ending at (0.9, 0.45).

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the average critic score over relative time for different GPT-4o policies. The x-axis, labeled "Time (relative)", has a linear scale with a range from 0.0 to approximately 0.9, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Average critic score", has a linear scale with a range from 0.2 to 0.8, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four lines: a solid green line representing "GPT-4o policy, successful" starts at approximately 0.3 and increases to 0.5; a dashed green line representing "GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, successful" starts at approximately 0.4 and increases to 0.8; a solid red line representing "GPT-4o policy, unsuccessful" starts at approximately 0.25 and remains relatively stable around 0.25; a dashed red line representing "GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, unsuccessful" starts at approximately 0.25 and increases to approximately 0.42.
